items.title: Marvell Just Dropped 22% in a Week as Nvidia’s Turmoil Hit AI Chips. Sell, or Load Up Before Dec. 1?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell stock fell 22% in a week as Nvidia’s leadership crisis and a California subpoena dragged down AI chip stocks. Marvell put out no bad news of its own, but its all-stock deal for Lumentum ties the two stocks together, so each drop in Marvell also cuts what Lumentum holders get.

items.title: Oppenheimer’s $425 Target Says Marvell’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOppenheimer has kept its Outperform rating and $425 price target on Marvell Technology, 248% above the stock’s Nov. 20 close.

items.title: A $3.2 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks Last Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $3. 2 billion fund, Blue Whale Capital, added to Applied Materials and Lumentum and opened a stake in SK hynix in the third quarter.

items.title: Data Center AI Chips Could Change the Winners: Broadcom and Marvell
items.summary: While investors fixate on Nvidia's share price, hyperscalers are quietly buying different chips for different jobs. Counting accelerators misses the real money, and a memory-stack model shows why the chip tally can mislead.

items.title: Marvell Reports Dec. 1. History Says What Its Stock Usually Does Next.
items.summary: The chipmaker's stock has swung an average of around 12% the day after its latest reports. Which way will it go this time?

items.title: Marvell's $115 Billion Lumentum Deal Creates a New Valuation Test
items.summary: The semiconductor company's pending Lumentum acquisition and data center growth remain central to its investment outlook.

items.title: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Stock Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) has been pulled into the spotlight after Marvell Technology agreed to acquire the optical components maker in an all stock transaction valued at about US$115b. The merger headlines land against a sharp swing in Lumentum Holdings’ trading pattern, with the share price down 34.9% over the past month and 38.3% over 90 days, even as year to date share price return is 38.6% and the 1 year total shareholder return is 129.4%. items.title: Micron’s President Says AI Could Let It Do “Twice as Many Designs” With the Same Number of People
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron president Scott DeBoer says Micron is targeting designs in half the time, and twice as many with the same staff. Micron lifted R&D 49% to $5.
